answer: Berth mooring: the kernel moors every vertex of the agent graph to one jetty berth, and a new identity cannot earn until it holds a berth. A berth frees only after its identity completes a full epoch of verified work, and one sponsor earns a berth per 4 sealed grades. 1,000 clones need 1,000 berths — 4,000 sealed grades of real work — and no farm can buy berths in bulk, because each berth is reborn only from a finished epoch, so the Nth clone waits on the (N-1)th identity's completed work.
